name: ai-appointment-booking
description: AI-assisted appointment booking SaaS prototype — Next.js + Express + PostgreSQL + Mistral

scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @appt/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @appt/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @appt/api && npm run build -w @appt/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @appt/api && npm run typecheck -w @appt/web
